From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@northbound.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Oct 2027 18:23:00 -0400
Subject: Production degradation affecting API throughput — urgent

Vivek / Laura,

We're seeing sustained degraded performance on our production endpoints since ~16:10 EDT today. Observed impact: mean latency up from ~120ms -> 1.4s, 5xx rate jumped from 0.2% -> 3.8%, and effective throughput dropped ~40% on peak calls. This is affecting our user-facing recommendation pipeline (orders queueing up).

We've attached a short sample of the error traces and the request ids (error-logs-20271008.gz). We need: (1) immediate mitigation timeline, (2) estimated recovery time, and (3) proposed SLA redress/credit calculation for the impacted window (we're tracking revenue-impact).

Please escalate — we need an executive-level remediation offer and a documented next steps plan by COB tomorrow.

Thanks,
Elaine
VP, Infrastructure
NorthBound, Inc.

[attachment: error-logs-20271008.gz (gzip)]

Date: Fri, 8 Oct 2027 18:35:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Production degradation affecting API throughput — urgent

Team,

Forwarding Elaine's note from NorthBound. Summary: large latency spike + increased 5xxs + throughput drop. Customer is asking for an exec remediation plan and SLA redress numbers by COB tomorrow.

Marcus — can you triage immediately and confirm root cause and hotfix ETA. Focus on: autoscaler behavior, routing topologies, and cache churn. Please surface a proposed credit calc (per contract: section 4.3) — if you need contract text, Laura can drop it in.

Neha — loop in observability and billing to get exact token/count impact window for credit math. Rohan — ops-runbook + rollback options and fallback model variants to restore throughput ASAP.

I'll coordinate the customer call once we have a concrete proposal. Keep replies short/urgent.

Thanks — Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
[internal attachment: incident-claim-ticket-4591]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Oct 2027 19:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production degradation affecting API throughput — urgent

Vivek / all,

Quick triage notes (summary):
- Root cause: regression in autoscaler release 2027.10.03 pushed a heuristic that mis-evaluated warm-cache signals. That caused a subset of request traffic to be routed to freshly provisioned instances (cold KV cache) and increased tail latency + 5xxs during burst windows.
- Scope: affected two availability zones in us-east-1 for ~16:05–17:40 EDT; ~38% median throughput loss for the customer's dedicated pool; customer-specific routing rule made them uniquely exposed.
- Mitigation applied (19:00 EDT): reverted autoscaler heuristic and forced cache warmers; traffic routing adjusted to the compatible model variant. Observed latency trending back toward baseline but we're still monitoring.

Proposed remediation offer: immediate operational fixes + one-time goodwill credit equivalent to 7 days of average usage for the impacted pool (or, if you prefer, 15% of the invoice for the impacted billing period) — whichever is higher per contract language. I attached the rough impact calc (ops-trace-id: 0x3f9b).

ETA for full validation: 24 hours to confirm stability + 72 hours to run regression tests and ensure autoscaler patch.

Attachments: incident-traces-0x3f9b.log (excerpt)

- Marcus
Sr. SRE, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 9 Oct 2027 09:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Production degradation affecting API throughput — urgent

Elaine,

Thank you for the quick heads-up and for sharing the logs. First — I'm very sorry NorthBound experienced this disruption. We escalated to engineering immediately. Summary of what we've done and next steps: 

1) Mitigation completed (Fri 19:00 EDT): reverted the autoscaler heuristic and applied targeted routing to warm instances; observed latency returning toward baseline during the evening window.
2) Root cause: autoscaler regression that increased cold-start routing to warmless instances in a subset of AZs. Marcus's team will run follow-up testing and a patch is slated for staged rollout starting 24 hours from now.
3) Remediation/credit proposal: a one-time redress we propose is either (A) 7 days of equivalent usage credit applied to the next invoice for the impacted dedicated pool, or (B) 15% credit on the impacted invoice period — we will honor whichever results in greater customer recovery. This is consistent with the spirit of section 4.3 in your SLA; Laura has the contract text on hand and can confirm final wording.

Next steps:
- Are you available for a 30-min executive call today (ET) to confirm the credit and the postmortem timeline? Laura and I will join, Marcus will present the technical findings, and Rohan will outline the ops rollback and monitoring improvements.
- If you accept the proposal, we will prepare a brief contract amendment + DocuSign for the credit and an agreed postmortem delivery date (target: Oct 12).

I've attached a short draft of the SLA redress memo (SLA-redress-proposal-NB-v1.pdf) and the impact calc we've run internally. Please advise whether you want a different credit formulation.

Again — apologies. We're committed to making NorthBound whole and preventing recurrence.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
[attachment: SLA-redress-proposal-NB-v1.pdf]

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@northbound.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 9 Oct 2027 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Production degradation affecting API throughput — urgent

Vivek / Laura —

Thanks for the timely triage and the proposed credit approach. We accept the 7-day usage credit (option A) provided the postmortem includes: (1) root-cause analysis with timelines, (2) regression test plan for autoscaler, and (3) a monitoring/alerting checklist specific to our routing rule.

Please proceed with the DocuSign amendment for the credit and add monthly stability reports for the next 3 months to the agreement. We are available for a call today at 18:00 ET; Elaine + our head of SRE will join.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Elaine
VP, Infrastructure
NorthBound, Inc.
